raw.query: WITH target_runs AS (SELECT run_id FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = TRUE AND run_id IN ('g4:F6_enc_fc_rho15', 'g4:F6_enc_static_C5')) SELECT i.run_id, i.achieved_p99_ms, i.bound_ms, i.is_violation, d.policy, d.rho, d.encoder_workers, d.superseded_by, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio AS cr WHERE cr.is_current = TRUE AND (cr.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM target_runs) OR cr.denominator_run = 'g4:F6_enc_static_C5')) AS matching_cost_ratio_rows FROM target_runs AS t JOIN provenance.v_dim AS d ON d.run_id = t.run_id AND d.is_current = TRUE JOIN provenance.v_infraction AS i ON i.run_id = t.run_id AND i.is_current = TRUE WHERE i.sla_metric = 'encoder_delay' ORDER BY i.run_id
